caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of fabric with a red background. The fabric features a repeating floral and botanical pattern where cream or beige flowers and blue-gray leaves are connected by brown and golden-yellow stems and tendrils. Occasionally, small clusters of round, light blue berries appear throughout the design. The plants and flowers are evenly distributed over the entire red surface, with the floral elements appearing stylized and outlined for emphasis. The edges of the fabric are cleanly cut except for the top, which displays a slightly frayed or uneven finish. The fabric swatch is positioned against a plain, neutral-colored background, and there is a handwritten text in the bottom right corner that reads "MARIE LUTTRELL 38."
title: Calico
